description:
Shared build infrastructure for the FIT-Connect modular SDK: plugin management,
        third-party dependency versions, the GPG signing profile, and the Sonatype
        Central publishing configuration. Each published module inherits from this POM.

        This artifact is versioned independently from the SDK modules and is bumped
        rarely (plugin upgrades, third-party version refreshes). It is published to
        Maven Central so external consumers building against the SDK source can
        reproduce the toolchain.
